bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to unemployment insurance; providing that acceptance of certain offers of deferred resignation do not constitute a quit from employment.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+ACCEPTANCE OF DEFERRED RESIGNATION IS NOT A QUIT. +]

[+Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 268.095, or any other law to the contrary, an applicant whose employer offered the applicant a deferred resignation, and who accepted that deferred resignation after January 27, 2025, and before February 13, 2025, is eligible for all unemployment benefits according to Minnesota Statutes, section 268.095, subdivision 10. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective retroactively from January 27, 2025. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to unemployment insurance; providing that acceptance of certain offers of deferred resignation do not constitute a quit from employment.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. ACCEPTANCE OF DEFERRED RESIGNATION IS NOT A QUIT.

Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 268.095, or any other law to the contrary, an applicant whose employer offered the applicant a deferred resignation, and who accepted that deferred resignation after January 27, 2025, and before February 13, 2025, is eligible for all unemployment benefits according to Minnesota Statutes, section 268.095, subdivision 10.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective retroactively from January 27, 2025.
additions: ACCEPTANCE OF DEFERRED RESIGNATION IS NOT A QUIT.

Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 268.095, or any other law to the contrary, an applicant whose employer offered the applicant a deferred resignation, and who accepted that deferred resignation after January 27, 2025, and before February 13, 2025, is eligible for all unemployment benefits according to Minnesota Statutes, section 268.095, subdivision 10.
This section is effective retroactively from January 27, 2025.
